This paper describes a cross-sectional human cohort study (196 subjects: 41 control, 56 pHTN, 99 HTN) plus a separate fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) experiment into germ-free mice using 2 HTN and 1 control human donor. The schema fields largely target oncology/neonatal/obgyn contexts not directly applicable here; most fields are not_reported.
Numeric age and BMI values were referenced as covariates but exact figures are located in Additional file 1: Table S1, which is not included in the provided text.

fmt_role and fmt_id fields are complicated by the two-tier design (human donors -> germ-free mouse recipients); exact donor/recipient IDs are in Additional file 11: Table S17, not provided in the text.
antibiotics_current_use and smoker fields were inferred from exclusion criteria rather than directly stated participant-level status; confidence downgraded accordingly.
Batch 2 returned granularity='study_level', differs from batch 0 ('subgroup_level'); kept batch 0.
Batch 2 subgroups [] differ from batch 0 ['control', 'pHTN', 'HTN']; kept batch 0.

Schema fields (biomarker_name/value/unit, disease_response_os, ecog_performance_status, tumor_size fields) appear designed for oncology/clinical trial studies and are largely not applicable to this gut microbiota-hypertension study; most were marked not_reported.

The study also includes a germ-free mouse fecal transplantation experiment (host species: mouse) in addition to the human cohort; host_species field was populated based on the primary human participant cohort per field description ('participant').

Detailed clinical biomarker values (SBP, DBP, FBG, TC, TG, LDL) are referenced only via p-values and thresholds in the main text; actual measured values reside in supplementary Table S1, which was not provided in the given text.
